votes.motion: Close the public hearing on CRA Budget Amendment No. 3 for Fiscal Year 2025-26
votes.description: The Board voted to close the public hearing held on the proposed resolution to amend the CRA's final budget for FY2025-26, which includes tax increment adjustments, interlocal agreement obligations, and other financial modifications.

votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of January 13, 2026, February 10, 2026, and March 24, 2026
votes.description: The Board approved the minutes from three prior CRA meetings held in January, February, and March 2026.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 10 of 2026, approving the Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Amendment No. 3 of the Salt Lake City Community Reinvestment Agency
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution amending the CRA's FY2025-26 final budget to reflect tax increment adjustments, interlocal agreement obligations, reimbursement agreements, additional interest revenue, a Library accounting adjustment, and a transfer from the Central Business District to Secondary Housing.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 11 of 2026, approving the Fiscal Year 2025-2026 funds to the Residential Wealth-Building Pilot Program Funding Allocations
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution approving approximately $6.4 million in funding allocations for two affordable homeownership developments—23 townhomes and 8 single-family homes—for households earning between 80% and 100% of AMI, as recommended by the selection advisory committee under the Residential Wealth-Building NOFA.
